from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one document: its title and the other papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper as found in the document")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers explicitly cited in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
